gaps.valueSet: Rule 4 generic Gram-stain tests constrained to urethral or endocervical specimen, plus organism-specific Gram-stain test-name alternatives
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no specimen-type evidence or predicate; the source HL7 specimen value sets are unavailable and both organism-specific Gram-stain test-name value sets have no codes. GON-R4 retains the coded Bacteria test-name branch whose value set itself is limited to genital and urethral specimens.
